hero.intro: Telecommunications engineer from INSA Lyon, with a year at Stockholm University. I started in electronics and embedded systems before moving to web and mobile. Today at Selego, between Amsterdam and Paris, I take startups from MVP all the way to scale: I build, I recruit and I train the teams.
